name: A Time Called You
s: A grieving woman magically travels through time to 1998, where she meets a man with an uncanny resemblance to her late love.

paragraphs.text: A Time Called You () is a 2023 South Korean time travel mystery romance television series written by Choi Hyo-bi, directed by Kim Jin-won, and starring Ahn Hyo-seop, Jeon Yeo-been, and Kang Hoon. Based on the Taiwanese television series Someday or One Day. It was released on Netflix on September 8, 2023.

A Time Called You is a story about Jun-hee, who is still grieving the loss of her boyfriend Yeon-jun in the year 2023, a year after his passing. She somehow travels back in time to 1998 and wakes up inhabiting the body of a different person, 18-year-old Min-ju. As she navigates this new reality, she meets Si-heon, who bears an uncanny resemblance to her deceased boyfriend, adding to the emotional complexity of her journey.
